register_citation.excerpt: | **AB-001** | Unhedged "proves universal nonextension" in finite corner reduction | Model promoted finite matrix minor bound ($q \ge 54/5$) to universal nonexistence of MUB(6) quartets. | Bounded minor establishes division-free algebraic equations for quartets; all-instance nonextension remains open conjecture. | **Finiteness Fence**: Never equate verified algebraic equivalence of finite-corner reduction with proof of universal nonexistence. |
